purpose: Single normalized implementation-facing source of truth for all 100 starting provinces, all 43 starting realms, and all currently locked regional formables/special identity systems.
authority: This master is compiled from the five locked regional identity canons plus frozen starting ownership. If a later regional canon is intentionally revised, regenerate this master rather than manually patching conflicting copies.

source_specific.note: Varellon is an established realm name distinct from its province names.
The Despotate style reinforces the eastern Corassi / old-Imperial-adjacent flavour.
Realm name derives from Aradon Merekh rather than matching a full province name.
Qasrûn is an established realm name derived from the broader Qasren cultural world rather than any single province.
Darun is an established realm name derived from Province 99 Zahraim Darun rather than a standalone province name.

formables.conceptual_condition: Any of the three fragmented Drevanic realms may establish a new broader Drevanic political identity by unifying the Drevanic homeland strongly enough.
special_rules: The eligible origins span both Open Furrow and Woven Root Drevanic realms.
Drevanor therefore must not assume one rite automatically replaces the other.

formables.conceptual_condition: Any of the three Kharven starting realms unites all eight Kharven provinces and proclaims a new pan-Kharven Khaganate-level political identity.
special_rules: This is the intentional highland/steppe unifier path inspired by the creation of a much larger political order from fragmented realms.
Kharuun is a new political identity, not merely an automatic rank-up of Namaruun, Talmir or Mino.

formables.conceptual_condition: Sorelion overturns the larger Kingdom of Avelor and reunites enough/most/all of the Selvaran homeland to justify a broader challenger identity.
special_rules: R027 Avelor may complete Selvaran unification and simply remain the Kingdom of Avelor.
Selvaron is a rare challenger formation, not an automatic culture-unification rename.

formables.conceptual_condition: Belisara overturns/supplants the mixed Banate of Vel-Kareth and gathers enough/most/all of the Vaskari homeland to establish a dedicated greater Vaskari state.
special_rules: R028 Vel-Kareth may expand through Vaskari territory and simply remain the Banate of Vel-Kareth.
The treatment of Western Province 30 Hasenmark in any exact Vaskara threshold is deliberately deferred.

formables.conceptual_condition: Veyran or Meyru overturns the dominant Sultanate of Samera and unifies enough/most/all of the Averi homeland to justify a new broader Averi identity.
special_rules: R043 Samera may complete Averi unification and simply remain the Sultanate of Samera.
Averash is a challenger formation, not an automatic culture-unification rename.

formables.conceptual_condition: The Sultanate of Darun overturns the larger Kingdom of Qasrûn and unifies enough/most/all of the Qasren homeland to establish the broader Qasraya identity.
special_rules: R035 Qasrûn may complete Qasren unification and simply remain the Kingdom of Qasrûn.
Qasraya is a challenger formation rather than a mandatory Qasren-unification rename.

formables.conceptual_condition: Either Tazhari starting realm may unify the four-province Tazhari homeland and establish the broader Tazhara identity.
special_rules: R039 begins Living Garden; R042 begins Veiled Spring.
Forming Tazhara does NOT convert the other rite or erase the rite-influence system.
The unifier inherits the need to govern a culturally unified but religiously mixed Tazhari homeland.

formables.conceptual_condition: One realm controls all 19 Avenic provinces and deliberately proclaims the pan-Avenic political identity Avenur.
special_rules: Avenur does NOT automatically become exclusively Living Garden or Veiled Spring.
Both normal Avenic rites remain legitimate inside the unified realm.
Political unification does not make the ruler head of the Concord of Aven.
Wellspring Summons remain a separate religious mechanism.

formables.conceptual_condition: Corvessa or Maravela overturns the dominant Despotate of Corassara and unifies enough/most/all of the Corassi homeland to justify a new broader Corassi identity.
special_rules: R033 Corassara may absorb the other Corassi lands and simply remain the Despotate of Corassara.
Coravessa is a challenger formation rather than a mandatory rename for Corassi unification.

formables.conceptual_condition: Conejolandia or Orellan overturns the established Kingdom of Solvarra and unifies enough/most/all of the Saleran homeland to justify a new broader Saleran identity.
special_rules: R019 Solvarra may unite the Saleran homeland and simply remain the Kingdom of Solvarra.
Salerra is a rare challenger transformation, not an automatic culture-unification rename.

formables.conceptual_condition: One realm controls all 18 core Mediterranean-culture provinces and deliberately proclaims Conejaria.
special_rules: Conejaria is the pan-Mediterranean political identity; it is not a religious title.
The strongly rabbit-Iberian linguistic flavour is intentional and must be treated seriously in-world.
Central Selvaran transition realms with strong Mediterranean influence are not part of the 18-province core condition.

formables.conceptual_condition: A Varethi realm unites the fragmented Varethi heartland strongly enough to establish a new shared Varethi political identity.
special_rules: Unlike Saleran and Corassi, no single starting Varethi realm is treated as the unquestioned established crown.

formables.conceptual_condition: The March of Eydvard overturns the established Skeldren order and unifies enough/all of the five Skeldren homeland provinces to justify a broader political identity.
special_rules: R022 Skeldmark is the established Skeldren power and does not need to rename when it completes Skeldren unification.
Under the current locked concept, Skeldharth is the exceptional challenger formation for R023 rather than a routine unification rename.

formables.conceptual_condition: One realm controls all nine Northern-culture provinces and deliberately proclaims a unified Northern crown.
Unite the Brevane lands strongly enough to proclaim a broader Brevane political identity.
Dominate enough of the Carthen homeland to rival/supplant Aldenreach.
special_rules: R010 Aldenreach does not need to rename when completing Carthen unification.
Exact role of Province 30 Hasenmark in the regional threshold is deferred.

formables.conceptual_condition: Dominate/unify the Haldren homeland strongly enough to justify a new broader Haldren identity.
special_rules: R004 Harenhold does not need to rename when completing Haldren unification.

formables.formable_name: The High Crown of the Western Warrens
formables.conceptual_condition: One realm controls all 19 Western-culture provinces, including Province 30 Hasenmark.
Unite the secular Velaine heartlands and reach sufficient regional power.
special_rules: Seravelle is not an eligible secular formation nucleus.
Formation must not inherently require conquest of Seravelle.

northern.note: Jarldom/Earldom/March/Kingdom are historical player-facing identities, not province-count ranks.

mediterranean.note: Titles are historical/political identities. A Duchy, County, Despotate, etc. can grow large without automatic promotion.

central.note: Central deliberately uses the broadest political vocabulary so far because it is a fractured imperial/cultural collision zone. Styles are historical identities, not province-count ranks.

eastern.note: Eastern player-facing titles are intentionally regionally distinctive. They are historical/political identities, not automatic province-count ranks.

imperial_restoration.eligible_identity_scope: Rethic Central successor realms belonging to the Elder Communion, excluding the existing Empire of Vorthyrion; exact realm-by-realm eligibility remains deferred.
imperial_restoration.concept: A non-Vorthyrion Rethic Central successor may eventually challenge Vorthyrion's claim to authentic imperial continuity by controlling the old Imperial heartland, substantial old-Imperial territory, and sufficient legitimacy/claim authority.
imperial_restoration.vorthyrion_rule: The Empire of Vorthyrion never needs to form a separate restoration identity. It already claims to be the authentic surviving Empire; reconquest is restoration of what it regards as rightful territory.
guardrails: Do not use 'Empire of Rethar' as the locked political name. Rethar is already the imperial ecclesiastical language name and should not be overloaded without a later explicit decision.
Exact territorial requirements, legitimacy rules, eligible successor list, final empire name and effects are deferred.
Old Sky Kharven realms are not part of this Rethic imperial-restoration path.

dormant_restoration_identities.concept: Some territories swallowed by Vorthyrion during its rise may later prove to contain dormant pre-Imperial political identities that can re-emerge under suitable conditions.
guardrails: Do not assume one dormant realm per current Vorthyrion province.
Do not assume all five Orthean provinces contain restoration identities.
A former realm may have spanned multiple present provinces.
The identities and their geography are created only when Central history justifies them.
Weakening Vorthyrion must not automatically shatter it into restoration states.
Restoration should require historically grounded conditions and legitimacy.

all_central_unification.rule: There is no generic formable for conquering all 36 provinces of the Central political sphere.
all_central_unification.reason: Central is a collision zone containing multiple Rethic successor cultures and rites, Kharven Old Sky lands, and the Western Carthen/Living Crown enclave Hasenmark. It is not one latent nation waiting to be formed.
all_central_unification.example: A gigantic Mino or Kharuun conquest of the whole Central sphere remains that historical realm/identity rather than transforming into a synthetic 'Central' state.

rules: Starting rite is heavily dominant/stable in each province.
Rite influence may shift slowly through institutions/buildings, local happiness, ruler policy, neighbours, conquest and events.
The system must not create constant religious babysitting.
Substantial rite change may create meaningful unrest under bad conditions, but severe breakaways are rare.
Political formables do not automatically convert conquered provinces.

deep_wells.concept: The Rite of the Deep Wells is a latent/emergent Avenic tradition that may reappear through rare religious upheaval, especially a historically plausible breakaway realm.
guardrails: Deep Wells requires actual religious influence/history/instability conditions.
Its future realm name/style depends on where and how it emerges.
It must remain rare and narratively weighty.

wellspring_summons.concept: Rare defensive/restorative collective sacred-war mechanism supported by influential scholars, institutions and respected Concord figures.
guardrails: Avenur does not gain automatic ownership/control of the Wellspring Summons.
No single political ruler becomes the Avenic pope-equivalent.
The mechanism remains rare, voluntary and threat-driven.

concord_of_aven.rule: No Avenic ruler automatically becomes head of the Concord of Aven through conquest, realm formation or Avenur unification.
